source_span.display_excerpt: Synthetic issuer confirms a funded, 36-month supply contract for 200 units, conditional on site qualification.
Synthetic counterparty independently confirms its executed purchase obligation and committed funding for those 200 units.

materiality.significance_rationale: The three-year obligation matters to the issuer's stated capacity plan.
materiality.what_changed: An executed funded obligation became public.
